mapper.select: SELECT BOARD_ID AS boardId, BOARD_TITLE AS boardTitle, BOARD_CONTENT AS boardContent, BOARD_VIEW_COUNT AS boardViewCount, BOARD_DELETED_FL AS boardDeletedFl, BOARD_CREATE AS boardCreate, IS_ANONYMOUS_YN AS isAnonymousYn, ANONYMOUS_NAME AS anonymousName, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, NICKNAME FROM BOARD JOIN MEMBER USING(MEMBER_ID) WHERE BOARD_DELETED_FL = 'N' ORDER BY BOARD_ID DESC

SELECT B.BOARD_TITLE, B.BOARD_CONTENT, B.BOARD_VIEW_COUNT, B.BOARD_DELETED_FL, B.BOARD_CREATE, B.BOARD_UPDATE, B.IS_ANONYMOUS_YN, S.SNACK_ID, S.DETAILS, S.BLOOD_SUGAR_F, S.BLOOD_SUGAR_S, S.FASTING_GLU, S.EXER, S.TASTERATING FROM "BOARD" B JOIN "SNACK" S ON (B.MEMBER_ID = S.MEMBER_ID) WHERE B.BOARD_DELETED_FL = 'N' AND B.BOARD_TYPE_ID = 2 ORDER BY S.SNACK_ID DESC
